spatial.decision: Run through .5 unless a hard rejection, resource limit or clearly growing invalid mode intervenes. Continue towards at most 6 if hard admissible, affordable and gradient/traction/profile/balance changes are interpretable; improvement in every error is not required. No automatic extension beyond 6.
spatial.usefulness: Compare initial and evolved traction, physical profiles and gradients, full weak component loads, interface/divergence, common normalized selected residuals, and signed/absolute bound supply. Reference traction discrepancy .00734465 is the baseline scale; a change >1e-5 in mean traction and >1e-8 common-normalized field norms is resolved. Two meshes show sensitivity, not an order.
spatial.correction_caution: Supply normalized by K0*24/(2/.4) above 1e-3 over a .1 window calls for diagnosis, not silent acceptance as uncorrected dynamics. Existing hard gates remain authoritative.

late_temporal.parent: H=.5 graded Regularized/Linear accepted T=6 native checkpoint
late_temporal.domains: U/k all physical domain; complete transported epsilon .5<=z<=4. Common quadrature resolves union of interfaces. One common pressure mean over both regions retains relative offset.
late_temporal.limits: Maximum 8 wall hours per triplet; at most two concurrent IVPs, one rank/thread each, <=16GiB RSS each. Extend elapsed horizon only up to .5 if a resolved response exceeds targets or slow adjustment prevents interpretation. Ordinary changed-dt restart remains invalid.
late_temporal.estimates: D_c=norm(q_dt-q_dt/2), D_f=norm(q_dt/2-q_dt/4). Assign p and Richardson only above floor with coherent scaling. Report estimates for original coarse and middle dt explicitly. Otherwise absolute sensitivity and unresolved order. This local IVP does not estimate accumulated 0-to-6 error.
